_comment: Copy to the .claude folder in your user profile, named speak-config.json. Run scripts/speak-voices.ps1 to see what this machine actually has. Every field is optional; omitting one keeps its default.
_engine: jaws | nvda | onecore | sapi | auto  (auto = a running screen reader, else onecore)
_voice: Substring of the voice id or display name, from speak-voices.ps1's 'match' field. Ignored for jaws and nvda.
_rate: onecore: 0.5 to 6.0 (6 fastest). sapi: -10 to 10. null = fastest. IGNORED for jaws and nvda, deliberately - rate there is the user's own setting.
_interrupt: Whether a new reply cuts off the previous one still speaking.
_nvdaClientDll: Full path to the NVDA controller client DLL. Leave empty to auto-search. It must match the architecture of PowerShell, not of NVDA, and it does NOT ship with NVDA.
_content: What actually gets spoken. Only Claude's own prose is ever read - thinking, tool calls and tool output are never spoken regardless of these settings.

content._codeBlocks: announce (say 'Code block omitted') | omit (skip silently) | read (speak the code)
content._urls: link (say the word 'link') | omit | read (speak the whole URL)
content._firstParagraphOnly: Speak only the opening paragraph. Good for long replies you will read yourself.
content._maxChars: Stop after this many characters and say 'Response truncated'. 0 = no limit.
